title: Scalar derived reconstruction on disjoint closed rank supports
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], and choose $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant. Write $Z_n=\{r=n\}$ using [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], with inclusion $j_n:Z_n\to Z$. For every $n\geq0$ let $E_n$ be an arbitrary module sheaf on $Z_n$. Set $T^q=j_{q,*}E_q$ for $q\geq0$ and $T^q=0$ for $q<0$, and let $C$ be the zero-differential complex with these terms. For any $K\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ with $H^q(K)\cong i_*T^q$ as scalar module sheaves for all $q\in\mathbb Z$, there is an isomorphism $K\cong Q(i_*C)$, where direct image is applied termwise. No finite-image assumption on r, no regularity assumption on i, and no action of $i_*\mathcal O_Z$ on K is required.

proof.text: Each rank fiber Z_n and its complement are closed in Z. Since i is closed, V_n=Y minus i(Z minus Z_n) is open, and V_out=Y minus i(Z) is open. They cover Y, and V_m intersect V_n is contained in V_out for m≠n. Each i*T^q is supported on the closed image of its own stratum, so restriction to V_n leaves only degree n and restriction to V_out is zero. The rank supports are locally finite, even if r has infinite image.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext (Koszul-complex computation of the derived sheaf Hom)

proof.text: Exact restriction commutes with cohomology. On V_n the object K has cohomology only in degree n, isomorphic to the restriction of i*T^n. The canonical upper and lower truncation maps identify it in the derived category with that cohomology sheaf placed in degree n. The zero-differential comparison complex restricted to V_n has the same cohomology and the same single-degree reconstruction. These operations can be carried out in standard derived categories on the opens, then transported through their representative localizations.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext (Koszul-complex computation of the derived sheaf Hom)

proof.text: Apply exact extension by zero from V_n and use the derived shriek/restriction adjunction to obtain counit maps from these extended restrictions to K. Form their derived coproduct using termwise representatives. Homology commutes with this coproduct. In each degree and at each point of i(Z), exactly one relevant rank support contributes, and the counit is the identity under the open restriction comparison. Outside i(Z) every cohomology stalk is zero, including every summand. Hence the coproduct counit is an isomorphism on all cohomology stalks and is a derived isomorphism. Apply the same argument to Q(i*C). Compose the coproduct of the extended single-degree isomorphisms with the two counit isomorphisms. Empty Z gives zero objects and rank zero gives the degree-zero case; no finite sum of idempotents and no gluing of arbitrary derived maps is used.
